name: Homemade Breakfast Sausage
desc: Ground pork seasoned with sage, thyme, brown sugar, and red pepper flakes, formed into patties.

source.title: Homemade Breakfast Sausage
source.evidence: Amounts for the site's seven seasonings on 1 lb pork; the page's dried parsley and rosemary are left out because the site recipe never had them.

ingredients.raw: 1 tsp vegetable oil, for the skillet

steps: In a bowl, mix the salt, pepper, brown sugar, red pepper flakes, garlic powder, thyme, and sage into the pork with your hands until evenly combined.
Scoop about 3 tbsp of the mixture per patty and flatten into 2 1/2-inch patties, about 8 total.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the patties until browned on both sides and 160°F inside, 4 to 5 minutes per side.
tips: For deeper flavor, cover and refrigerate the mixed sausage for 1 hour before shaping.

references.site: Beyond The Chicken Coop (Wayback Machine copy)
references.title: Homemade Breakfast Sausage
references.usedFor: 3 tbsp scoop, 8 patties, 4 to 5 minutes per side, optional 1-hour chill
